protocol.confidence_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over per-seed scores; synthetic-seed uncertainty only
protocol.prediction_protocol: heldout_prediction.py defaults: train cycles 1-200, freeze, test 201-300; fixed F1 threshold 0.5
protocol.recovery_protocol: ground_truth_recovery.py defaults: train cycles 1-200; hidden labels withheld from models

known_tags.delta_convention: comparison model minus reference; positive favors comparison model

including_test_only_tags.delta_convention: comparison model minus reference; positive favors comparison model

clean.delta_convention: comparison model minus reference; positive favors comparison model

overlapping.delta_convention: comparison model minus reference; positive favors comparison model

stress.delta_convention: comparison model minus reference; positive favors comparison model

difficulty_trends.quantity: (Organica F1 - baseline F1) in harder condition minus the same gap in clean condition
difficulty_trends.positive_means: Organica's relative F1 position improved as the condition became harder
difficulty_trends.interval_rule: 95% percentile bootstrap interval wholly above/below zero indicates a relative improvement/worsening; otherwise inconclusive

limitations: PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed at 0 to control process-level enumeration variation, not estimated as another uncertainty source.
F1 uses the preregistered fixed 0.5 threshold; no threshold is tuned on test data.
Organica G1 strengths are not calibrated probabilities; its Brier and log-loss comparisons are descriptive.
Structure recovery is undirected pairwise same-cause recovery, not intervention-based causal discovery or held-out regime prediction.
The overlap and false-correlation levels are controlled synthetic stress conditions, not a representative distribution of natural worlds.
The prediction curriculum is deterministic and identical across seeds; its intervals reflect Organica's seeded sleep RNG only, while baseline scores repeat on the same stream.
Recovery seeds vary synthetic samples and Organica's seeded sleep RNG; neither task samples real-world environments.
